english.title: Tampering with a motor vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or reasonable cause,

(B)_[tampered with the brake or other part of the mechanism of]_

a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), whilst it was on a

english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offences must not be confused with the offence contrary to section 9 of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981, motor vehicle interference see offence wording at: H588.
(ii) This offence may only be committed on a road or parking place provided by the local authority.
(iii) For the purposes of this offence, mechanism includes any equipment in or on the vehicle designed to allow the motion of the vehicle to be controlled other than by an individual in the vehicle, or to facilitate its being so controlled, and, any software installed in, or other electronic information stored in, any such equipment.
